mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of observations where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% (p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% (UNRATE < 7.5%) signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 7.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs overall mean).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% and CPIAUCSL monthly change ≤ 0.1% indicate stable monetary policy without inflationary pressure, generating positive S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL conditions.

mechanism_narrative: In post-GFC recovery regimes, INDPRO > 100 signals strengthening industrial output, supporting corporate profitability and generating positive S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of observations during post-GFC recovery periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1050 thousand units indicates robust housing market activity, reflecting consumer confidence and demand for goods, producing positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1050.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO > 100 signals expanding manufacturing output, reducing inventory constraints and increasing corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS levels above 400,000 million dollars indicate strong retail sales, driving consumer spending and corporate revenue growth for positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of observations where RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent PAYEMS > 135,000 and UNRATE < 7.7% indicate labor market strength, increasing household income and consumption for positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting both PAYEMS and UNRATE conditions.
